title: 'I am not a criminal': Uganda opposition leader Bobi Wine hits back from hiding
summary: Ugandan opposition leader Bobi Wine on Wednesday insisted that he was "not a criminal" while still in hiding after escaping what he said was a police raid on his home ahead of last week's presidential election.
